title: kg_hooks.new_lanes judges a merge commit by diff-tree names alone, so a changed kb gitlink counts as a code path and the pre-push hook refuses a merge that was content before the gitlink fix
goal: the merge-commit branch of kg_hooks.new_lanes leaves a kb submodule root's gitlink out as kblane.commit_paths does

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kg_base,kg_hooks
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a,ok=True): return subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@example.com",*a],cwd=d,check=ok,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
def link(n): g("update-index","--add","--cacheinfo","160000,"+n*40+",kb/team")
g("init","-q","-b","main")
open(d+"/a","w").write("1");g("add","a");link("1");g("commit","-qm","base")
g("checkout","-q","-b","side");link("2");g("commit","-qm","s")
g("checkout","-q","main");link("3");g("commit","-qm","m")
g("merge","--no-ff","-m","mg","side",ok=False)
link("4");g("commit","-qm","mg")
kg_base.KB=d;kg_hooks.KB=d
r=kg_hooks.new_lanes(["HEAD^!"])
sys.exit(0 if r and r[0][1]=="content" else 1)

repro_reason: needs a merge commit that changes a gitlink under kb; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 6 (S3). kg_hooks.py:87 (new_lanes, merge-commit branch) feeds diff-tree --name-only -c to paths_lane; path_lane no longer calls a bare kb/<name> content, only commit_paths strips the gitlink, so a merge whose changes hold a kb gitlink is now a code path and the hook refuses a merge that was content before. Fix: filter the gitlink in that branch too (a kblane helper both call). Planned in SP-wjrxikw6 2026-11-10: touches, order and repro checked against the base.
